svg.title: Synthetic map origin comparison
svg.desc: Synthetic teaching data. Geometry axes use metres; velocity axes use seconds and metres per second.

g.text: Map origin: same cells, changed map coordinates
Synthetic occupancy | north-first image | same axes and equal metre scale
20 x 16 cells | resolution = 0.25 m/cell | shift = 0.50 m = [2, 0] cells
The coordinate assignment changes; the obstacles have not physically moved. No real venue measurements.
